payload.reason: The evidence provides insights into the performance differences between CGExpan and LM-Base, particularly in the context of user-generated text versus well-curated benchmarks.

claims.text: CGExpan performs well on well-curated benchmarks but underperforms on user-generated text compared to LM-Base.
LM-Base outperforms CGExpan on user-generated text due to its ability to handle the characteristics of such text better.
SOTA methods like CGExpan do not generalize well to user-generated text, leading to significant performance drops.
